replication.note: V2 §8.1: the L=5 episodes of one task may be identical under a deterministic runner. This is reported BEFORE the main results. `effectiveReplication` is the MEAN number of distinct within-task results actually resolved, taken over the LEARNING arms (Arm-0 is excluded because it never updates, so its constancy is definitional). It is NEVER `episodes`: the L episodes are not L independent observations. When every analysed task is constant in every learning arm the design is binary and `effectiveReplication` is exactly 1.
replication.effectiveReplicationDerivation: max over LEARNING arms (writesBack=true) of mean(distinctRunValues per analysed task); set to exactly 1 when every analysed task is constant in every learning arm. allLearningArmsConstant=false, per-arm means=Arm-1:1.333333, Arm-2:1.333333, Arm-3:1, Arm-4:1

collinearity.thetaTrackReducedForm: θ_track_i = −(θ_write_i + θ_gate_i) — exact whenever the quality arms reproduce the frozen reference
collinearity.disclosure: In this fixture the quality arms reproduce the FROZEN reference on every analysed task (Arm-3 ≡ Arm-4 ≡ Arm-0). Consequently θ_track is NOT an independent measurement of the track factor: it satisfies the exact identity `θ_track = −(θ_write + θ_gate)` (residual printed above), which contains no quality-row term at all. θ_track and θ_write are therefore rank-deficient with respect to the track factor, and θ_track’s `above-MMI` band is NOT positive track evidence. Only the process row of the gate factor is identifiable, and the interaction term is unidentifiable because the two quality cells are identical.

declarations.microsIsNotUsd: micros is a UNIT CONVENTION (1 USD = 1,000,000 micros), not an incurred spend; the rate card is an offline fixture model
declarations.powerIsClosedFormApproximation: closed-form normal approximation ((z_1-a/2 + z_1-b) / sqrt(N)), NOT an executed power analysis; the N=10 value is 0.8859 (the superseded V1 figure 0.886)
declarations.primaryTestPolicy: the §8.6 controlled family uses the SAP-designated primary test per series type: exact paired randomization (sign-flip) for rate-type series (§8.3.2), exact McNemar only when the series is binary (§8.3.1). Multiplicity (Holm) is applied to that primary p-value.
declarations.verdictIntervalPolicy: the §8.5 ③④ dimensions read the ESTIMATOR interval (randomization inversion of mean Δ); the Clopper-Pearson interval of the discordant-pair win probability π is reported as a separate descriptive quantity and is NOT the verdict interval.
declarations.externalValidity: 12 synthetic tasks provide mechanistic/feasibility evidence only; they are NOT a production significance claim and must not be generalised (V2 §8.7)
